description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe sitting in a chair at at table on the porch holding a white cat in her lap while getting her wet hair combed by a woman standing behind her who dressed in a white dress and apron (possibly Margaret Prosser); O'Keeffe sits with her head turned to the left with eyes looking slightly down, she is dressed in a white short sleeved blouse with a fuzzy-textured vest.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe Getting Her Hair Cut
